title: Quadrilateral Security Dialogue
description: Strategic dialogue between Australia, India, Japan, and the United States
extract: The Quadrilateral Security Dialogue, sometimes referred to as the Quad, is a grouping of Australia, India, Japan, and the United States that is maintained by talks between member countries. The dialogue is widely viewed by newspapers and think tanks to be a diplomatic arrangement responding to increased Chinese economic and political power.
